title: Concept: AML risk grade exposed in a customer payload
description: An AML risk score or grade field on a customer record in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: An AML grade tells an attacker which customers the bank watches least, and the grade itself is derived from suspicion data the customer must never see.
applicability: Deployments that render an AML risk score or grade field on a customer record into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: An AML grade tells an attacker which customers the bank watches least, and the grade itself is derived from suspicion data the customer must never see.
